threatModel.summary: A public static Pages application builds checksum-labelled government discovery data from repository-vendored OKF source snapshots and exposes five read-only or reversible-presentation WebMCP tools. Primary risks are source substitution, untrusted-content execution, cross-origin retrieval, resource exhaustion, privacy leakage and release-evidence spoofing.
